owner: wv_sig -- independent verification of src/sig/api.py and src/sig/levers.py (read and run only; I edited nothing)
summary:
ELEVEN CLAIMS RE-RUN FROM SCRATCH IN A HARNESS I WROTE, EVERY CELL IN A FRESH PROCESS, BOTH DIRECTIONS ON EVERY REFUSAL, AND A PRE-EDIT TREE REBUILT FROM HEAD SO THE 'BEFORE' HALF IS MEASURED RATHER THAN QUOTED. TEN OF THE ELEVEN HOLD AS STATED; ONE IS NARROWER THAN CLAIMED.

WHAT HOLDS. All eight work-list items and all three consequential cells reproduce exactly, in both directions, at the numbers they print -- including the ones easiest to embroider: SIG_D=0's all-zero `z @ z.t()` INCLUDING ITS DIAGONAL and the EXACTLY 1.0 separation over a nan loss; the SIG_TEMP=inf / SIG_TEMP=1e30 bit-identity (loss 4.845168113708496, grads 265.2186584472656 / 134.94387817382812 / 274.1432800292969, 800-step separation 0.9927038550376892 in both); the SIG_VAR_WEIGHT nan / -inf / 0.0 off-arm identity (0.006581897847354412 in all three); the SIG_SPACE=tokens slot ceiling (emb.weight (4096, 0), FAB pop.cent (4096, 0)); and the shipped default, which is BIT-IDENTICAL to the pre-edit baseline (verdict='budget' steps=800 probes=1 peak=0.5237941741943359, same gate line).

THE MOST IMPORTANT NEGATIVE RESULT: NO SENTINEL WAS BROKEN. The three refused zeros are not declared sentinels anywhere (the sweep's own legitimate-specials list does not contain them), and every SIG zero that IS declared -- dense_window=0, warmup=0, warmup_min_frac=0.0, warmup_plateau_eps=0.0, var_weight=0.0, cov_weight=0.0, prototype_frac=0.0 -- still builds and still behaves as its gate says. I ran all seven. -0.0 is admitted and lands on the off arm, not on a refusal. Both arm gates hold in both directions, and no legal FINITE configuration I could construct is refused.

WHAT DOES NOT HOLD, and it is the pattern this round exists to catch -- A NARROWER FALSE UNIVERSAL WRITTEN INTO THE FIX. src/sig/api.py::warm_up now says '`int(frac * budget)` cannot raise for a finite negative against a non-negative int budget'. It can: SIG_WARMUP_MIN_FRAC=-1e308 against the shipped SIG_WARMUP=800 overflows the product to -inf and the by-name refusal dies inside its own f-string -- `OverflowError: cannot convert float infinity to integer | at api.py:1132` -- which is the exact defect they closed for -inf, one comment later, at a finite value the new check admits. The +inf twin is live too (1e308 -> a bare OverflowError at api.py:1135), as is the same overflow in build's radius derivation (1e308 -> OverflowError at api.py:502). The REFUSALS are right; the SENTENCE is not.

OVERSTATEMENT AUDIT: that one sentence is the only one. Every other docstring and comment they wrote says what is closed and names what is not -- 'it closes THREE SPELLINGS ... It does NOT bound them, validate them or make them safe', with 1e30/1e38 measurements beside it -- and I confirmed those measurements myself rather than taking them.

TWO DEFECTS NOBODY REPORTED, BOTH IN THEIR FILE, BOTH THE SHAPE THE BRIEF NAMED. (1) `max(curve)` in _stop_verdict and warm_up: max keeps its first argument when the comparison is False and every comparison with NaN is False, so at SIG_VAR_WEIGHT=8e37 -- FINITE, admitted, measured -- warm_up returns verdict='budget' peak=0.7668829560279846 final=nan over an encoder whose every parameter is non-finite: a healthy-looking peak, a spent budget, and the 'collapsing' RUN-LEVEL FAILURE arm unreachable because every nan comparison is False. Identical on the pre-edit tree, so it is theirs to fix rather than theirs to have broken. (2) Gate sig.adaptive_stop prints fired=True with reason='' and the pair (floor vs budget) on EVERY plateau stop, not only at the inf they attributed it to -- the flatness arithmetic that fired it is nowhere on the line, and K16 files this gate under the population it does not judge (its `fired` is `verdict == 'plateau'`, which renders neither printed number) while K15 reads a reason that is empty. That is the half neither check covers.

SUITE: census is 2 FAILING on the tree as it stands, which contradicts their 'MATCHES THE STATED BASELINE EXACTLY'. It is NOT SIG's: with only src/memory/levers.py restored from HEAD in a scratch copy and every SIG edit left in place, census passes 8/0. Full output and the proof are in suite_after.

ONE QUOTED NUMBER IN THEIR REPORT DOES NOT REPRODUCE: 'SIG_TEMP=1.0 -> budget 800 1 0.43072396516799927' is the DEFAULT's number; their own quick.py gives 0.9971050024032593 at 1.0. Every other non-default number they quote reproduced to the last digit.

WHERE: src/sig/api.py::warm_up's final `else` arm -- `Gate('sig.adaptive_stop', verdict == 'plateau', floor, budget, reason=('...collapsing...' if verdict == 'collapsing' else ''))`. When the plateau stop fires, the operator's line reads fired=True with value=floor, threshold=budget and reason='' -- the floor-vs-budget pair states only that the stop was ELIGIBLE; the arithmetic that actually fired it (`abs(sep - prev) <= eps * abs(prev)` and `sep >= 0.85 * peak`) appears nowhere on the line, and neither does eps.
MEASURED, CURRENT TREE, AT A LEGAL FINITE eps:
  $ python3 wv.py --stream A SIG_WARMUP_PLATEAU_EPS=1.0 SIG_WARMUP_PROBE_EVERY=200
    [warm_up] verdict='plateau' steps=400 probes=2 peak=0.5347145199775696 final=0.5347145199775696 curve=[0.453574, 0.534715]
    [gate] fired=True value=200 threshold=800 reachable=True reason=''
  (200 vs 800 is floor vs budget; the stop fired on |0.534715 - 0.453574| <= 1.0 * 0.453574.)
WHY NO CHECK CATCHES IT: K16 only judges a Gate whose `fired` expression resolves to a comparison whose operands the printed pair renders. Here `fired` is `verdict == 'plateau'`, which renders neither `floor` nor `budget`, so the gate falls into the population K16's own report calls DESCRIPTIVE (or unresolved) and prints as not judged -- '27 whose pair renders no clause of their own verdict ... and is left alone; 79 whose verdict does not resolve to any comparison'. K15 reads the reason TEXT, and an EMPTY reason names no lever, so it has nothing to check either. This is exactly the 'half neither covers'. The same arm prints reason='' on the 'budget' outcome too, i.e. armed-and-did-not-fire with no arithmetic beside it.
